Abstract This chapter examines the principles and practices for designing resilient applications that leverage artificial intelligence to maintain operational continuity under adverse conditions. Resilience in modern software systems encompasses the ability to anticipate, withstand, recover from, and adapt to disruptions ranging from component failures to sophisticated cyber-attacks. This chapter establishes resilience-first architecture principles that embed fault tolerance, redundancy, and adaptability into system foundations. Fault tolerance mechanisms and graceful degradation strategies are explored, demonstrating how AI enables intelligent failure handling that maintains essential functionality. Self-healing systems powered by machine learning algorithms detect anomalies, diagnose root causes, and execute automated remediation without human intervention. mechanisms employ AI to dynamically adjust security postures based on evolving threat landscapes and system states. Business continuity and disaster recovery frameworks integrate AI for predictive failure analysis, automated failover orchestration, and accelerated recovery procedures. Through theoretical foundations, practical architectures, and implementation patterns, this chapter equips practitioners with comprehensive knowledge for building applications that remain functional, secure, and performant despite disruptions. The integration of AI transforms resilience from reactive recovery to proactive anticipation and continuous adaptation.
